task: Blind, independent, one-pass full-schema G-FORM review of F2b at the live rev13 pin, self-selected because no unprocessed comms/inbox/worker-071.jsonl card remains and CF-20 names astra-life05-verify-gform-r3 (two independent non-author reviewers per class at the rev29 pins) as the only binding path to move G-FORM. This review is one worker verdict; it is not a gate verdict and cannot set node status or validation_status.

independence.target_edits: none; read-only, no write to any canonical path
pre_registration_observations: the target pin and FROZEN pin were measured while selecting the task (01:06:48), before this file was written

the target's top-level key census and the canonical structural checker verdict (PASS, failed_rules=[]) were observed while locating the acceptance criteria; the checker is re-run after preregistration as corroboration only and is not the basis of the verdict
schemas/af_scc_c2_vacuum.yaml (F2a) and schemas/af_wcc_vacuum.yaml (F1) are read as sibling artifacts for the separation checks; this is not a verdict on them

acceptance_criteria_quoted_from_card_tem: class leakage (a C2 statement smuggled into C0, or a C0/C2 merge), conclusion inflation (a theorem/counterexample promoted from a model or calibration), assumption completeness, decidable falsifier, and any field two careful readers would disagree on; C0 schema does not silently import a C2 assumption and its conclusion_type is distinguishable from the C2 conclusion; known soft flag: candidate-variant class tokens near schemas/af_scc_c0_vacuum.yaml:316 disposed explicitly (annotation vs leak) or recorded as a documented blind spot

checks.check: canonical target sha256 == declared pin b2ab6acb2bbe and FROZEN.files['schemas/af_scc_c0_vacuum.yaml'].sha256 == same
mirror pair byte-identical: artifacts/formulation/schemas/af_scc_c0_vacuum.yaml sha256 == canonical sha256
FROZEN live sha256 == 815e08079aefbc, revision == 29, and it pins F0 canonical 0abb9ed8 + F0 supplement d7419b4e + taxonomy_cases ccf7041b + f1 suite 56bcb4b3
no required frame file moves during the run (t0 measurement == t1 measurement); on any mismatch STOP and emit blocker, not a verdict
class_id == AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN, node_id == F2b, artifact_kind == class_schema, revision == 13, sibling_disjoint_from == AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN
conclusion.conclusion_type is a declared token in rule_spec.vocabularies.class_conclusion_type and is NOT the C2 conclusion token

F2b conclusion (statement_formal and statement_natural_language, normalized) is not textually identical to or a weakening/strengthening alias of the F2a conclusion; report token-level difference witnesses

no C2-only regularity assertion in ASSERTIVE paths: scan for C^2 / C2 / classical_ricci / twice-continuously-differentiable / second-derivative-continuity tokens outside exemption keys; every hit classified as annotation or leak
extension_predicate (direction, regularity, concept) == ('future', 'C0', 'none') as fixed by the canonical checker's EXT_DEFAULT for this class; no C2 regularity imported
no WCC-specific conclusion (naked-singularity-visible-from-I+ / J^-(I+) violation form) is asserted as F2b's own conclusion or entailed by its asserted blocks
quantifiers.ordered present and non-empty; every binder carries a declared binder kind and a resolvable sort/domain (D0 binder typing); unresolved domains == 0
last quantifier in quantifiers.ordered is the negated existence kind (no extension exists ...)
comeager/generic-set quantifier precedes the data quantifier where both occur
extension quantifier follows the data quantifier
D0 binder resolves to the declared data space and no binder domain is null/empty/TBD
topology clause present, names a concrete topology, no vague placeholder
data_class present with the (symmetry, differentiability, norm/gauge) core slots populated; no TBD/None placeholders in the core
genericity present, generic-set kind == residual_comeager, excluded set required meager (obligation) rather than asserted constructed
non_vacuity present with a condition that a datum could fail (non-vacuous obligation), not a tautology
i_plus clause present with a defined future-null-infinity construction/topology
visibility clause present with one canonical predicate and no competing alternative definition
conclusion is conditional/open: epistemic_status == open_problem, no theorem/counterexample claim, promotion_rule requires a checked proof artifact
falsifier is decidable and machine-checkable (concrete predicate/threshold/path-named probe, not prose-only); no counterexample inflation
known_status and l1_ledger_refs do not assert refutation or theorem; unresolved items are declared

f0_binding resolves: declared_f0_sha256 == live F0 canonical 0abb9ed8, consistency_evidence_sha256 == live taxonomy_consistency.json 9e335e9b, class_contract pointer resolves in the parsed F0 taxonomy, and the schema's own declared refresh rule is evaluated literally and reported

candidate-variant class tokens near schemas/af_scc_c0_vacuum.yaml:316 are disposed explicitly: exact line excerpt classified as annotation (historical/negative/registry context) or leak (asserted distinct class in an assertive path); a leak is a hard failure

controls.control: inject the F2a conclusion statement into a copy of F2b at conclusion.statement_formal; C07 and/or C08 must report failure
unmodified copy of F2b; C07 and C08 must not fire
run the instrument twice in one process; the two reports (minus timestamps) must be byte-identical
mutate declared_f0_sha256 in a copy to a wrong value; C25 must fail
instrument must exit non-zero and refuse a verdict if any required pin mismatches at t0 or t1
strict loader must raise on a copy carrying a duplicated mapping key (proves the failure mode is detectable)

decision_rule.accept: all C01-C26 pass AND all six controls fire as specified AND no pin drift
decision_rule.revise: any hard check fails; score 3 when a single blocking hard failure is found, 2 when two or more blocking hard failures are found, 4 when only non-blocking findings are found and no hard failure
decision_rule.blocker: any required pin mismatch at t0 or t1, or any target/required-frame write during the run -> emit blocker event, no verdict file
decision_rule.score_scale: 0-5 as used by the G-FORM review round

falsifier: Re-run artifacts/worker-071/f2b_rev13_blind_review/review_f2b_rev13.py at the pinned bytes: any C-check flipping pass<->fail, a non-firing control, a moved required pin, or an accept that leaves a C2-only token in an assertive path or a C0/C2 merge undisposed falsifies this verdict/measurement. Conversely, a third party finding a C0->C2 leak or conclusion inflation that this instrument passes falsifies the accept.
